cross_cutting_mbo_finding.the_gate_in_action: 0318 and 0325 are the twin cases. Both are give-back-exhaustion reversals off a mature down-chain sitting on a floor/cum-extreme. In BOTH the prior day exited DOWN into the close (0317 last_hour_dir -1, close_off_low 0.30; 0324 last_hour_dir -1, close_off_low 0.16) - meaning the turn had NOT begun in the seam; it realized AFTER the open (0318 at the 02:24 stop-run-and-reverse, 0325 at the 20:38 open off the cum-low). So the boundary state MANDATES holding the confirmed base (+1500 on 0318, ~+600 on 0325) and NOT chasing the reactive tail (+1900 / +660). The prior-exit direction is the discipline that keeps the honest-under-100 bar honest.

summary.the_boundary_gate_finding: The round-2 value-add is a MAGNITUDE GATE derived from the prior day's last_hour_dir at the seam.
